comments.author: henrikbost
comments.body: Under burst load the pool drains and callers block forever — there is no acquire timeout and no saturation metric, so the first traffic spike wedges every worker silently.

comments.author: mariadahl
comments.body: Added the acquire timeout plus pool-depth gauges, load-tested to 3x burst with zero stuck acquires (run 5227, green). This thread is done.
